description: Reads the DKIM public key published at <selector>._domainkey.<domain>: key type, whether it is revoked (empty p=), decoded key size in bytes and a strength hint (about 1024-bit vs 2048-bit RSA), and basic syntax (v=DKIM1). Follows one CNAME, which large providers use. Does not check a signed message. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

selector.description: DKIM selector such as k1 or google (required)
